name: spec-explainer
title_zh: 一份 spec 配一条人声解说，没写过它的人也能听懂
tagline_zh: OpenSpec / spec-kit 的变更提案，不用读原文也能懂。生成带语音旁白的逐步讲解。
tagline_en: Turn an OpenSpec/spec-kit change into a spoken walkthrough. Non-authors can grasp it without reading the.
desc_en: Turn a spec-driven change (OpenSpec, spec-kit) into a narrated walkthrough with generated voice-over, so someone who did not write the proposal can understand it without reading it. Use this when someone asks for a proposal, spec, change or RFC to be explained, walked through, summarised, presented, or turned into a video. It explains a change that already exists; it does not write, implement, rev
why_zh: 它不总结要点，而是按 diff 顺序一步步讲变更动机和影响，配生成语音，让听比读更省力。
why_en: Narrates the diff step-by-step, focusing on intent and impact, not just bullet points. Voice makes it digestible while.
limit_zh: 只解释已存在的 spec 变更，不负责写提案或改代码；需要能访问原 spec 文件；产物是语音讲解。
limit_en: Only explains existing specs; won't write or implement changes. Needs spec file access. Output is audio narration only—no subtitles or visuals.
title_en: A spec gets a narrated walkthrough, so non-authors get it
